newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco sells two-star hotel at $1.15 million.
newsitem.headline: Morocco sells two-star hotel at $1.15 million.

text.p: Morocco on Thursday launched a public tender for the sale of a two-star hotel in the northern city of Larache at $1.15 million, the ministry of privatisation said.
With 18 rooms, four bungalows and two suites, the Riad hotel is sited in nearly two hectares (five acres) of grounds in the Atlantic Coast tourist city.
The ministry set 10 million dirhams as minimum price for the sale and a closing date for subscription as December 9, 1996.
Under its privatisation programme, Morocco has already sold 45 state-owned companies, including hotels. It plans to privatise 70 other enterprises by end 1998.
